author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: दीप्तयोरनलार्कयोर्द्युतिरिव द्युतिः प्रकाशो यस्य तमित्युक्त्या प्राप्तपरिमितशङ्काव्युदासायोक्तमप्रमेयमिति अमितद्युतिमित्यर्थः ॥ ११.१७॥
translation:
With diadem, mace, and discus, mass of splendour, shining everywhere, Thee I behold-Thee dazzling the sight, radiant on all sides like the blazing fire and sun, (yet) unmeasurable. 
V. Yet unmeasurable: this epithet removes the idea of finiteness shadowed by the simile before it.
